# CleverStack - Full-Stack Web & App Development Studio

> CleverStack is a full-stack development studio building fast, scalable websites and web applications for founders and growing businesses in the USA, UK, and Europe.

## Services
- Starter Website ($499): Up to 5 pages, mobile-responsive, SEO foundation
- Business Website ($999): Up to 10 pages with CMS, custom theme, advanced SEO
- E-Commerce Store ($1,749): Up to 20 products on Shopify or WooCommerce
- Custom Web App ($3,000): React/Next.js/Laravel dashboards with auth and APIs
- SEO & Growth ($549): Full technical SEO audit, keyword research, on-page optimization
- Fix & Redesign ($799): Site audit, redesign, speed optimization
